entities.summary: Hennadii Mykolayovych Shapovalov is a Ukrainian Ground Forces major general who is the Commander of the Ukrainian Ground Forces from 19 June 2025. He served as the commander of the Operational Command South from 16 April 2024 to 4 February 2025.
